name: Cheyava Falls
summary: Rock in Neretva Vallis that Perseverance studied in July 2024, about 1 m across with white veins and "leopard spots". NASA announced it in September 2025 as a potential biosignature.

measurements.label: Rock type
measurements.value: mudstone; grains approximately ≤30–110 μm in diameter, finer than coarse silt or very fine sand

measurements.label: Rock size
measurements.value: arrowhead-shaped rock measuring 1 meter by 0.6 meters

measurements.label: Organic matter (SHERLOC)
measurements.value: detected by the SHERLOC instrument, based on the presence of an approximately 1,600 cm⁻¹ G band in the Raman spectra

measurements.label: Leopard spots
measurements.value: distinct spots with circular to crenulated dark-toned rims and lighter-toned cores, about 200 μm to 1 mm in diameter; they appear to represent in situ reaction fronts

measurements.label: Spot rims (PIXL)
measurements.value: enriched in Fe, P and Zn relative to the mudstone they occur in

measurements.label: Spot cores (PIXL)
measurements.value: a phase enriched in S, Fe, Ni and Zn was detected

measurements.label: Minerals in the nodules and reaction fronts
measurements.value: ferrous iron phosphate and sulfide minerals, likely vivianite and greigite, respectively

measurements.label: Conditions of those reactions
measurements.value: geological context and petrography indicate that these reactions occurred at low temperatures

measurements.label: Veins
measurements.value: large white calcium sulfate veins running the length of the rock

measurements.label: Red bands between the veins
measurements.value: reddish color suggests the presence of hematite

measurements.label: Olivine (PIXL)
measurements.value: an approximately 0.5–1-mm-diameter olivine grain in an approximately centimetre-thick, light-toned Ca-sulfate layer

measurements.label: Olivine and carbonate grains
measurements.value: olivine sand grains and particulate and intragranular Fe–Mg carbonate were observed in Cheyava Falls and Steamboat Mountain

measurements.label: Biosignature status
measurements.value: potential biosignature: a substance or structure that might have a biological origin but requires more data or further study before a conclusion can be reached about the absence or presence of life

measurements.label: Core sample
measurements.value: Sapphire Canyon, sample no. 25, sealed July 21, 2024 (sol 1215); rock core, 6.2 cm; sedimentary
